title: Matrix inverse by Gauss-Jordan elimination
summary: Invert a square matrix with row operations and partial pivoting, and raise an error when the matrix is singular.

mutants.no_pivoting: Always uses the diagonal entry as the pivot, so a zero or tiny pivot breaks the result.
mutants.no_singular_check: Does not raise an error for a singular matrix and divides by zero.
mutants.first_nonzero_pivot: Takes the first row with a non-zero entry as the pivot, and not the row with the largest entry.
mutants.eliminates_below_only: Clears the entries below each pivot but not above it, so the left half does not become the identity.
